name: postfader-fl-studio-mcp
description: FL Studio MCP server: read, mix, compose, and edit your open FL Studio project with Claude.
long_description: PostFader connects Claude to the FL Studio project you have open. Claude can read the mixer, channels, plug-ins, and patterns; check exported mixes for loudness, peaks, tonal balance, and vocal masking; write chords, melodies, basslines, and drums; pick presets from the instruments you loaded; and run multi-step jobs. PostFader starts read-only, reads every supported change back from FL Studio, and never saves your project. Before installing this extension, install the matching Python package and run `postfader setup`: the extension does not install FL Studio's controller script or set up a virtual MIDI port.

midi_port.title: Virtual MIDI endpoint
midi_port.description: Exact endpoint name shared with FL Studio. PostFader does not install or configure a virtual MIDI provider.
